findings.summary: Reader direct-hit lookup repeats the same search-hit request and validation shape already present in the Editor reader.
findings.consequence: Future changes to the generated search-hit contract, window validation, or stale-response guard can drift between Reader and Editor; this is maintainability risk rather than an observed behavioral defect in this packet.
findings.evidence: The owned function at lines 1351-1387 builds /works/{work_id}/search-hits params, validates with isExpectedHitResponse, checks total_hits, and extracts workSearchHitAt. The direct dependency/counterpart app/pages/editor/[lbid]/ix/[ix]/[mediatype].vue lines 1110-1144 performs the same request/validate/extract sequence for Editor navigation.
findings.recommendation: Extract the shared request-window helper behind route-specific validators, for example fetchValidatedWorkSearchHitWindow({ client, workId, mediaType, state, pageMap/current, offset, limit, expectedHitIndex, signal }), and keep Reader-specific freshness checks in hitLookupIsCurrent.
